newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: SABIC first half 97 net up 1.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: SABIC first half 97 net up 1.3 pct.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's industrial giant Saudi Basic Industries Corp said on Monday it made a 2.30 billion riyal net profit in the first half of 1997, up 1.3 percent from 2.27 billion riyals a year earlier.

Figures released by SABIC, 70 percent owned by the Saudi government, showed sales income stood at 11.90 billion riyals at end-June 1997, up from 9.94 billion at end-June 1996. Expenses rose to 8.08 billion riyals from 6.08 billion.
Operating income ebbed to 3.82 billion riyals in the first six months of 1997 from 3.86 billion a year earlier.
Shareholders' equity grew to 27.41 billion riyals from 25.74 billion and total assets increased to 63.61 billion riyals from 60.55 billion.
